name: float-input
title: Float Input
description: A text field whose label starts inside the box and floats up when you focus or type.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the label. Floats up on focus or when the field has a value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every change.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown only once the label has floated.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon at the start of the field.
